about: Editorial pronunciations for the Kokoro voices (Decision 078). An entry overrides misaki's lexicon, the build rules and the neural guess. Keys match without regard to case. An entry is {"ps": phonemes} for both dialects, {"us": ..., "gb": ...}, or {"like": a respelling the lexicon reads}. "plays" holds entries for one play only, keyed by play id. The build's report (phonemes-report.json in the play library) lists every guessed word by frequency: review its top, then add entries here. Symbols: misaki's (catalog/tools/play_phonemes.py VOCAB).
